session_sequence.fresh_request_requirement: Acquire the current value through the game's live request-construction path; do not replay or extrapolate a captured value.

authenticated_attribute_plaintext_field_.note: This aggregate records no envelope bytes or cryptographic key material.

current_build_rpc_proxy_evidence.meaning: The game owns request encoding and transport dispatch. This proves a client proxy surface, not an externally callable ABI or permission to invoke it.

architecture_assessment.assessment: Normal UI placement is observed, but no reviewed world-to-screen, camera, navigation, or ground-raycast adapter can deterministically reproduce an arbitrary saved coordinate.

This is the preferred exact-coordinate architecture because the normal high-level game path can own sessionSequence, action identity, time, authenticated attributes, framing, ordering, and retransmission. Its exact-current-build method ABI and coordinate parameter boundary remain unresolved.
The proxy would preserve transport allocation, but a caller would still need a complete current request including live session and authenticated action fields.
The repository capture path is passive. It has no inline connection owner, sender, retransmission engine, or sequence-safe rewrite layer. Side injection must remain prohibited.

recommendation.preferred_exact_coordinate_path: Resolve and invoke the exact-current-build high-level normal marker action while leaving request construction and transport ownership inside the game.
recommendation.ui_fallback: Use normal UI automation only when approximate placement is acceptable.
recommendation.prohibited_path: Do not synthesize, replay, inject, or rewrite application bytes on the live TCP stream.
